title: Microvascular Plug Embolization of Anterior Spinal Artery Bearing Segmental Arteries Prior Aortic Stenting: Technique and Safety
summary: Patients who received MISACE procedure, and all identified patients are given age, gender, planned surgery or intervention, history of previous procedures, findings prior to the procedure, procedural features, follow-up findings and results of the blood tests up to 6 months after the primary procedure will be documented and evaluated anonymously.
conditions: Disorders of arteries, arterioles and capillaries in diseases classified elsewhere

interventions.name: The hospital's electronic database is searched for all patients who received MISACE procedure, and all identified patients are given age, gender, planned surgery or intervention, history of previous procedures, findings prior to the procedure, procedural features (angiographic findings, used materia

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients who underwent MISACE procedure in the interventional radiology unit.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients who have not undergone the MISACE procedure in the interventional radiology department.
